engine.hint: Full backups, incremental chains and standalone checkpoints. New packages are verified before registration.
engine.source_consistency: Files are captured individually; SQLite uses the Backup API. Other live databases and services need native backup mechanisms. Whole-project consistency is not guaranteed.
engine.secrets_warning: Without encryption, archives and content storage may contain secrets. Access is restricted by OS permissions and project access. Choose encryption or explicitly exclude secret files.
engine.chain_hint: Incremental backups depend on the full parent chain. Transfer every archive in the chain and the key if encrypted. Restore controls arrive in stage 5.
engine.key_hint: An administrator provisions a key separately and configures only its file path. Keys are stored apart from archives. Keep a separate protected key copy: lost keys cannot decrypt data. Policy changes do not encrypt old backups.
engine.auto_delete: Allow automatic cleanup of new backups
engine.schedule_hint: Schedules run while the application is running. Missed intervals become one job after startup. Incremental needs an existing point with the same policy. Cleanup requires separate policy opt-in.
engine.cleanup_hint: Deletes only new unprotected backups outside the policy that no retained chain needs. Legacy archives are preserved. History metadata stays; deleted points become unavailable.
engine.completed: A job finished. Refresh the recovery point list.
engine.unsafe_path: Unsafe path or symbolic link. Operation stopped. Check project exclusions: unneeded virtual environments can be excluded; symbolic links are not archived.
engine.unsupported_file: A special file (such as a socket or FIFO) was found. Operation stopped: exclude the unneeded service file in project settings.
engine.storage_permissions: Storage and keys must belong to the service user with private permissions (directories 0700, files 0600).
engine.space: Insufficient free space including the safety reserve.
engine.busy: Project is busy or the concurrency limit was reached.
engine.key_location: Keep the key outside project, archive, content and temporary directories.
engine.key_invalid: A binary 256-bit key (32 bytes) is required.
engine.source_changed: Source files changed during capture. Retry after writes stop.
engine.sqlite_unstable: Could not capture a coherent SQLite/WAL copy. Stop writes and retry.
engine.format: Unsupported format or archive limits exceeded.
engine.missing: File or recovery point is missing.
engine.chain: Dependency chain is missing, corrupt or incompatible.
engine.parent_required: Create a full backup before an incremental backup.
engine.parent_policy: Policy changed. Create a new full backup.
engine.retention_disabled: Cleanup is disabled by the retention policy.
engine.access: Initiator permissions were revoked or the project was disabled.
engine.queue_full: Queue is full. Wait for jobs to finish.
engine.cancelled: Job cancelled. No successful point was published.
engine.shutdown: Job stopped during shutdown. Check the operation log.
engine.interrupted: An interrupted job is not automatically repeated. Check points and create a new job.
engine.io: Filesystem or SQLite error. Project data was not modified.
engine.internal: Internal job error. Check settings and the log.
engine.confirm: Explicit cleanup confirmation with delete is required.
engine.platform: This stage filesystem engine supports POSIX/Linux. Windows needs native reparse-handle validation during the installation stage.
restore.wizard_hint: Restore starts with point verification and a preview. Files are written only after confirmation.
restore.destination: Absolute path of a new directory
restore.files_label: Files: one relative path per line
restore.selection_hint: For selected files, enter paths from the chosen point. For a new directory, enter a path that does not exist yet.
restore.preview_hint: The preview expires in 15 minutes, is bound to your session and is single use. Changed data requires a new preview.
restore.legacy_warning: This is a legacy archive. Its bytes are checked against the recorded SHA; consistency of the live source service at capture time is unknown. Legacy SQLite with WAL/journal requires a separate correct import.
restore.process_warning: Open files or process working directories were detected. Stop those processes normally yourself and create a new preview. PIDs:
restore.process_incomplete: Process detection is incomplete: not every process descriptor is visible. You must ensure services and writes to this directory have stopped.
restore.insurance_hint: A protected Pre-Restore Backup is created and verified using the current policy and key. If it does not cover affected files (for example excluded secrets), overwrite is blocked: an administrator must choose a suitable storage policy and repeat the preview.
restore.scope_hint: Restore uses the shared exclusion scope of the current project and point. Excluded directories, application storage and nested registered projects are preserved. Metadata Only cannot be restored.
restore.atomic_hint: Changes to an existing tree are applied per file with a journal and undo. Whole-directory atomicity is not guaranteed. A failure never triggers automatic rollback: open the journal and explicitly choose recovery.
restore.acknowledge: I reviewed the changes, stopped services and writes using this directory, and approve replacing/deleting the listed files.
restore.readonly: Restore requires Administrator or an Operator with explicit restore permission for this project. History remains readable.
restore.recovery_hint: The operation was interrupted. Conflicting project actions are blocked. Preview undo recovery or recovery from insurance. Files changed after interruption cannot be silently overwritten.
restore.running_hint: Job status and cancellation are available in Backups. Refresh this page when finished.
engine.restore_pending: An unresolved restore blocks this project. Open Restore and explicitly choose recovery.
engine.restore_source: Restore source is unavailable in this project.
engine.restore_metadata: Snapshot does not contain complete verifiable content. Metadata Only cannot be restored.
engine.restore_legacy_sqlite: Legacy SQLite archive contains WAL/journal without consistency guarantees. A separate verified import is required.
engine.restore_stale: Project, point or settings changed. Create a new preview; the old confirmation does not authorize this state.
engine.restore_new_only: This mode requires a new directory that does not exist yet.
engine.restore_target: Target overlaps another project, a leased directory or application storage.
engine.restore_selection: Choose 1–1000 files present in the point and permitted scope.
engine.restore_scope: Directory replacement would affect excluded or unselected files. Change the selection and create a new preview.
engine.restore_mount: Operation crosses filesystems or a nested mount. Safe apply is unavailable here.
engine.restore_permissions: Insufficient permissions for safe read, write or verification.
engine.restore_atomic: Filesystem does not support safe no-clobber rename. Operation stopped.
engine.restore_access: Explicit restore permission and the initiator’s active session are required.
engine.restore_missing: Operation was not found in the accessible project.
engine.restore_preview: Preview expired, was already used or belongs to a different session.
engine.restore_confirm: Approve the changes and stopped writes, and type the exact word RESTORE.
engine.restore_journal: Operation journal could not be verified.
engine.restore_workspace: Staging/undo is unavailable or its identity changed. Preview the insurance point; unknown data is preserved.
engine.restore_process: Another process is using this directory. Stop writes normally and create a new preview.
engine.restore_safety: Insurance backup is missing, invalid or does not cover affected files. Overwrite is forbidden.
engine.restore_verify: Result did not match the verified plan. Explicit journal recovery is required.
engine.restore_interrupted: Restore was interrupted. No automatic rollback occurred. Open Restore: undo and insurance are retained.
engine.restore_failed: Operation stopped before applying files. Create a new preview after resolving the cause.
engine.restore_cleanup: Files were restored; private staging/undo could not be fully cleaned up. It remains preserved and excluded from scans.
engine.restore_conflict: Files changed after interruption or do not match undo. They were not overwritten. Use a new insurance-point preview with new insurance for the partial state.
restore.retained: Private undo/staging is retained for safety and excluded from scans. These data are not automatically deleted.
engine.restore_sqlite_family: A standalone SQLite WAL/SHM/journal cannot be restored. Use a verified coherent backup of the database itself.
analysis.history_hint: Metrics belong to the selected snapshot. Old results are preserved; scan settings affect new analysis only.
analysis.fallback: Unsupported languages retain file history, hashes, backup and restore. Only trusted installed adapters run; project code is never executed.
audit.unconfirmed: These are review hints, not confirmed vulnerabilities. No fixes or rollback run automatically.
audit.identity_hint: Identical structural findings in one file are grouped; the first line is shown. Reviews are shared within this project and persist across matching snapshots.
audit.baseline_required: Select a baseline snapshot for new-only filtering.
audit.legacy_why: Historical heuristic; severity is preserved, not independently confirmed.
audit.legacy_fix: Review the original context or create a new analysis; historical rows are not rewritten.
logs.window_hint: Search and level filters cover the last 2 MiB, after masking. Up to 2000 matching lines; this is not a full-file search.
logs.truncated: A bounded window is shown; earlier or excess matching lines are omitted.
sqlite.private_hint: Read-only private copy. Sensitive columns are masked, blobs hidden. Each request captures a new state; views, virtual tables and generated columns are not evaluated.
sqlite.truncated: Result limited to 128 KiB and 4096 characters per cell.
inspection.path: This path is outside the permitted inspection scope.
inspection.timeout: Inspection time limit exceeded; use a smaller offline copy.
inspection.size: SQLite capture exceeds the 64 MiB inspection limit.
inspection.changed: The source changed during reading; refresh or stop its writer.
inspection.sqlite: SQLite is unavailable, inconsistent or exceeded its query limit. The source was not modified.
inspection.tables: Too many tables or unsupported table names.
inspection.table: Select an ordinary stored table from this database.
inspection.columns: Too many columns or unsupported column names.
rules.shell.why: High: shell parsing may interpret untrusted input; input trust is not established by this check.
rules.shell.fix: Review inputs; prefer an argument list with shell disabled.
rules.dynamic.message: Dynamic code or unsafe deserialization API
rules.dynamic.why: High: these APIs can execute code when data is untrusted; exploitability needs manual review.
rules.dynamic.fix: Validate the trust boundary; prefer a safe parser or explicit dispatch.
rules.timeout.message: HTTP call without an explicit timeout
rules.timeout.why: Medium: the call can wait longer than intended; wrapper defaults are not resolved.
rules.timeout.fix: Set a bounded connection/read timeout or verify the configured client default.
rules.tls.why: High: a literal verify=False bypasses certificate validation.
rules.tls.fix: Enable verification and configure a trusted certificate authority.
rules.bind.why: Medium: 0.0.0.0 may expose a listener; this literal alone does not prove a public service.
rules.bind.fix: Review bind settings, authentication and firewall scope.
rules.sql.message: Constructed SQL passed to an execute-like call
rules.sql.why: High: formatting can mix data and SQL; the receiver and input trust are not proven.
rules.sql.fix: Use bound parameters for values and allowlists for identifiers.
rules.secret.message: Possible credential stored as a string literal
rules.secret.why: High: a credential-like variable has a nonempty literal; it may be a harmless example. Value is hidden.
rules.secret.fix: Review privately; move real credentials to protected configuration and rotate if exposed.
rules.exit.why: Low: process termination is often intentional; it is not itself a security vulnerability.
rules.exit.fix: Confirm the lifecycle and cleanup behavior.
rules.syntax.message: Python syntax could not be parsed
rules.syntax.why: Info: analysis is incomplete; this is not a vulnerability verdict.
rules.syntax.fix: Check syntax and Python version, then run analysis again.
rules.read.fix: Check access and file stability, then retry.
rules.limit.why: Info: source exceeds the analyzer size or nesting limit; backup remains available.
rules.limit.fix: Inspect this file separately; no source changes were made.
rules.plugin.message: Analyzer failed or returned unsupported results
rules.plugin.why: Info: this file has no complete analyzer result. Error contents are not exposed.
rules.plugin.fix: Review the installed trusted adapter; file history remains available.
rules.secret_file.why: Info: classification by filename, not proof of a leaked credential.
rules.secret_file.fix: Review permissions and the backup secret/encryption policy.
rules.private_key.message: Possible private key embedded in source
rules.private_key.why: Critical: a private-key marker indicates potentially severe credential disclosure; validity is not tested.
rules.private_key.fix: Inspect privately, remove real keys from source and rotate exposed credentials.
auth.setup_code_hint: On the server, run $HOME/ProjectTimeMachine/bin/ptm setup-code and enter the result. It is only needed to create the first administrator.
auth.setup_code_invalid: Initial setup code is missing or invalid. Read it using ptm setup-code on the server.
delete.project_warning: Irreversible: project history, snapshots and backups will be deleted. Source files are retained. After an error, confirm again to finish cleanup.
delete.archive_warning: Recovery from this backup will become impossible. After an error, confirm again to finish cleanup.
delete.confirm_error: Confirmation is invalid, expired or already used. Open confirmation again.
delete.busy: Deletion is blocked by pending jobs or unfinished recovery.
delete.storage: Unsafe or nonstandard storage path: deletion blocked.
delete.pending: Cleanup is incomplete. Retry deletion of the disabled project.
delete.referenced: Backup is referenced by recovery history or a live restore preview.
